payload.title: Close domain-robust original-view objective before implementation
payload.decision: Reject H021/T028 at the preregistered worth gate; preserve E011 as deployment primary and require a fresh independent-mechanism selection before any new model work.
payload.rationale: The T027 original-only signal cannot be repaired by scalar placement and has substantial per-well oracle opportunity, but the weaker domain-oracle gain is only 0.0397890310 RMSE versus the frozen 0.05 floor. Spatial group 3 and typewell group 4 have adverse first derivative at zero, so no nonzero common placement improves every domain. Implementing GroupDRO, CVaR, robust loss, or jackknife objectives is not evidence-authorized.
payload.revisit_trigger: Do not retune objective thresholds, evaluator groups, placement, or one-view coefficient targets. Revisit only with a materially independent legal candidate/action whose covariance or causal state evidence is verified before implementation.
